description: Na₅MoNO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent MoNO₄ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one N and four equivalent O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.43 Å. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. Mo is bonded to one N and four equivalent O atoms to form distorted MoNO₄ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. The Mo-N bond length is 1.76 Å. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.99 Å. N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. O is bonded to five Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₅Mo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-39°.
